### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>cncf-tags/container-device-interface (tags.cncf.io/container-device-interface)</summary>

### [`v1.1.1`](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/releases/tag/v1.1.1)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1)

#### What's Changed

- spec: Fix comment to reference containerEdits field by [@​zrezke](https://redirect.github.com/zrezke) in [#​303](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/303)
- cdi: inject mount UID/GID mappings if user NS is in use. by [@​klihub](https://redirect.github.com/klihub) in [#​288](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/288)
- cdi,SPECS.md: allow empty cgroup permissions. by [@​klihub](https://redirect.github.com/klihub) in [#​301](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/301)
- .github: bump golangci-lint to v2.9.0. by [@​klihub](https://redirect.github.com/klihub) in [#​307](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/307)
- add local build and install procedure in README.md. by [@​fujitatomoya](https://redirect.github.com/fujitatomoya) in [#​305](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/305)
- Revert to default spec dirs if none are specified by [@​elezar](https://redirect.github.com/elezar) in [#​310](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/310)
- SPEC.md: fix a few typos/clarify a sentence. by [@​klihub](https://redirect.github.com/klihub) in [#​312](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/312)
- add beginner's tutorial to see how CDI works. by [@​fujitatomoya](https://redirect.github.com/fujitatomoya) in [#​311](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/311)
- Makefile: add GO\_EXTRAFLAGS to go build call by [@​koenkooi](https://redirect.github.com/koenkooi) in [#​313](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/313)
- Remove runtime-tools dependency by [@​elezar](https://redirect.github.com/elezar) in [#​317](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/317)
- schema: add validation for top-level container edits by [@​marquiz](https://redirect.github.com/marquiz) in [#​323](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/323)
- parser: guard single-character vendor and class names against a slice-bounds panic by [@​thc1006](https://redirect.github.com/thc1006) in [#​321](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/321)
- chore(deps): replace deprecated gopkg.in/yaml.v3 for go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​328](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/328)
- schema: make validation error private by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​329](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/329)
- pkg/cdi: stop embedding Cache mutex by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​335](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/335)
- build(deps): bump actions/stale from 10 to 11 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​327](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/327)
- specs-go: add test coverage by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​332](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/332)
- replace strings.Split for strings.Cut by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​336](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/336)
- schema, validation: minor fixes and modernization by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​330](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/330)
- pkg/cdi: deprecate ErrStopScan and use os.ReadDir for scanning Spec directories by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​339](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/339)
- Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​318](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/318)
- pkg/cdi: synchronize access to specDirs by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​337](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/337)
- schema: migrate to github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​331](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/331)
- pkg/cdi: fix deprecations, add doc-links and "go fix" by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​338](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/338)
- internal/validation/k8s: remove unused validation helpers by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​334](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/334)
- specs-go: remove x/mod semver dependency by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​333](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/333)
- chore(deps): github.com/stretchr/testify v1.12.1 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​342](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/342)
- ci: update golangci-lint to v2.13, and fix linting by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​352](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/352)
- ci: apply zizmor hardening fixes by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​350](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/350)
- specs-go: fix benchmark compatibility with go1.19 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​353](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/353)
- pkg/cdi: fix flaky TestRefreshCache by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​355](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/355)
- ci: test against oldest supported, oldstable, and stable Go versions by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​351](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/351)
- pkg/cdi: TestRefreshCache: consolidate cache state checks by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​357](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/357)
- build(deps): bump actions/checkout from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​349](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/349)
- remove "sigs.k8s.io/yaml" dependency by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​340](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/340)
- build(deps): bump actions/setup-go from 6.4.0 to 7.0.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​348](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/348)
- build(deps): bump golangci/golangci-lint-action from 9.2.1 to 9.3.0 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​346](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/346)
- build(deps): bump codespell-project/actions-codespell from 2.1 to 2.2 by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​347](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/347)
- pkg/cdi: fix, and cleanup some locks, and use RWMutex by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​345](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/345)
- update minimum go version to go1.23 and modernize some code by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​354](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/354)
- chore(deps): github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify v1.7.0 by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​359](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/359)
- pkg/cdi: clean up watcher lifecycle handling and simplify refresh logic by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​358](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/358)
- pkg/cdi: fix cache refresh handling for filesystem events by [@​thaJeztah](https://redirect.github.com/thaJeztah) in [#​344](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/344)
- Bump version to v1.1.1 by [@​elezar](https://redirect.github.com/elezar) in [#​361](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/361)

#### New Contributors

- [@​zrezke](https://redirect.github.com/zrezke) made their first contribution in [#​303](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/303)
- [@​fujitatomoya](https://redirect.github.com/fujitatomoya) made their first contribution in [#​305](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/305)
- [@​koenkooi](https://redirect.github.com/koenkooi) made their first contribution in [#​313](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/313)
- [@​thc1006](https://redirect.github.com/thc1006) made their first contribution in [#​321](https://redirect.github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/pull/321)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/cncf-tags/container-device-interface/compare/v1.1.0...v1.1.1>
